generatedCommentsNodes.comment: In `testEsqlRuntimeFields`, the bulk request body generation contains a logic error where `.replace("$o", offset)` is called, but the template string uses a hardcoded value `"offset":5` instead of a placeholder `$o`. Consequently, the randomly generated `offset` variable is ignored, and all documents with an offset have the same constant value.

review_comment: This is another bug. The value of mapped runtime fields wasn't added to ignored source.  I think we can also include this change in this PR. Otherwise some assertion in added PR need to be removed.
